verdict.rationale: Jeeves only mentions a 'one-click sync' with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero on its cross-border payments product page, with no documentation of bidirectional sync mechanics, real-time journal entry posting, or reconciliation workflows — nothing framed for a finance-lead's core ask of replacing manual journal entries. Missing for 10: technical detail on the sync direction/frequency, evidence of automated journal-entry creation, reconciliation guarantees, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that ERP sync works as claimed.
